# Board (web)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

The use case board, the Use Case Planner, the use case drawer and its panels, and agent runs.

## Files

- `BoardPage.vue`: The board: one column per stage, use cases as cards, filters and search.
- `CardClassifyReview.vue`: Assess risk: the Risk Classifier's tier, oversight and starting risks, decided item by item.
- `CardDesignReview.vue`: Controls: the Control Designer's proposed controls, decided item by item.
- `CardDraftReview.vue`: A drafting agent's draft (evidence, test, validate or report stage), decided item by item.
- `CardDrawer.vue`: The side panel for one use case: whatever decision it is waiting for (triage, classification, control design, an agent draft, a manual sign-off), its exit criteria, risks, controls, profile, runs and activity.
- `CardQuestionPanel.vue`: An agent's question for a person (rule 27): answer it or skip it.
- `CardRecord.vue`: The use case's record below the decision: classification, risks, the approved report, controls, profile, the agent's past questions, runs and activity.
- `CardStatusPanel.vue`: What the use case is doing when no decision is waiting: a failed run, an agent working, a stage a person does by hand, or closed.
- `CardTriagePanel.vue`: Intake: take the use case forward or close it with a note.
- `DraftItem.vue`: One item of an AI agent's draft (a risk, a control, a challenge, the tier): what the agent proposed, why, the sources it rests on, and the reviewer's decision.
- `FilterPill.vue`: A filter button in GoldenEye's style: "Label Value ▾", opening a small list.
- `NewUseCase.vue`: Quick add: the profile of a new AI use case typed straight in, without the Use Case Planner.
- `PlanPage.vue`: Plan a use case: where every use case starts.
- `RunDetailPage.vue`: One agent run: model, cost, tokens and its step-by-step log.
- `RunsPage.vue`: Every agent run in the engagement.
- `VerifierBar.vue`: The Verifier's line on a draft: its overall view, which model checked it, and a button to check (again).
- `drafts.ts`: Which items of an agent's draft a person decides on, mirroring the server's decisions.ts, so the board and the side panel can show progress.
- `use-card-drawer.ts`: Everything the use case side panel knows and does (v1.7.8: moved out of CardDrawer.vue so each panel is its own small component).

## Pages

| Address | Page |
|---|---|
| `/` | `BoardPage.vue` |
| `/plan/:id?` | `PlanPage.vue` |
| `/runs` | `RunsPage.vue` |
| `/runs/:id` | `RunDetailPage.vue` |

The server side is in [`apps/server/src/board`](../../../../server/src/board/README.md).
